t: You're looking at a terrace of houses in Westminster, 5 Lower Grosvenor Place and numbers 19 to 25 Victoria Square. They were designed by Matthew Digby Wyatt, who lived from 1820 to 1877. He was an architect and art historian who became Secretary of the Great Exhibition and Surveyor of the East India Company. He was also the first Slade Professor of Fine Art at Cambridge, and in 1866 he received the Royal Gold Medal.
